payload.title: A failed shared request must end the job with a receipt, not wedge the run
payload.description: Found via the worker diagnostic line: reserve raised RuntimeError(explicit retry required) for an item whose earlier attempt left a failed shared batch, which escaped as an unrecorded exception and left the claimed job running (run_busy for everything after). Map it to a recorded source_refused refusal (pre-dispatch, safe). Post-dispatch failures stay fail-closed.
